{{Top|leg}}
The Royal Houses in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] were led by the '''Juvex Lords'''. When the former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]] attempted to use her son, [[Irek Ismaren]], and the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' to [[Ismaren plot|revitalize]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] by attacking the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Juvex Lords, as well as the [[Senex Lords]] of the nearby [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], allied with her.
